value.content: {"cve_id": "CVE-2024-27956", "software": "WordPress Automatic Plugin", "cvss": 9.8, "vulnerability_type": "SQL_INJECTION", "cwe": "CWE-89", "affected_versions": "Versions before 3.92.1", "architecture_root_cause": "The plugin exposed an unauthenticated endpoint at /wp-content/plugins/wp-automatic/inc/csv.php that accepted a query parameter 'q' which was passed directly into $wpdb->query() without escaping or using prepared statements.", "detection_signals": ["wp_automatic_csv_endpoint", "unauthenticated_direct_php_file", "q_parameter", "direct_wpdb_query"], "verification_strategy": "Test whether providing a harmless SQL boolean expression in the 'q' parameter yields differential CSV output or an empty result versus a syntax exception.", "evidence_requirements": ["csv_differential_content", "unauthenticated_200_with_query_dependency"], "remediation": "Update to version 3.92.1 or newer; restrict unauthenticated direct access to script files; utilize $wpdb->prepare() for all database interactions."}
